name: jack-and-jill
description: Jack & Jill brand tooling for the terminal: a measured Claude Code theme and the palette in every terminal's own syntax.

plugins.name: jj-brand
plugins.description: The Jack & Jill palette as a Claude Code theme (two grounds, 72 roles, every pair measured against WCAG AA) plus a terminal kit: Terminal.app, Ghostty, iTerm2, Kitty, Alacritty, WezTerm and VS Code configs, a brand status line, LS_COLORS/bat/fzf/git colours, and a one-click ground toggle.
